thread:
Ana: Quick idea — add a tiny interactive "price composer" widget on the pricing page hero and the FAQ microflow. Users pick model size, avg tokens per call, and monthly calls and it shows an estimated monthly bill + recommended tier. A/B vs current static table. @Mike @Sarah
Mike: Nice. Do we have a ready component we can reuse or do dev need a new micro-app?
Julia: We have a calculator snippet from last year (embeds/price-calc v0.3) but it lives in growth repo; needs styling and accessibility pass.
Sarah: Key asks: 1) microcopy that clarifies "Committed" vs "On-demand" 2) single-line CTA when estimate > threshold routes to sales 3) keep embed super fast (no heavy images).
Prashant: For routing, prefer enriching the HubSpot lead with a hidden field "interest_level" (values: "estimate","committed","enterprise") and set prefill if they pick commit >100k tokens. Then workflows can auto-assign to AE pool.
Ana: UX microcopy proposal (first pass): "Estimated monthly cost shown here is for planning only. Committed plans offer discounts and SLA — contact sales to get a custom quote." Thoughts?
Mike: Shorten: "Estimate for planning. Committed plans include discounts & SLAs — contact sales for quotes." Feels cleaner.
Julia: Accessibility note: calculator must expose results as text region for screen readers and allow keyboard-only interactions.
Sarah: A/B plan: Variant A = interactive widget in hero + CTA routes to sales modal when estimate > $2k; Variant B = current static table with updated FAQ microcopy. 50/50 for 4 weeks. Track conversions (signup, demo requests).
Ana: Also want a tiny FAQ accordion item added: "How do you calculate pricing?" include bullet about token lengths, batching, and caching. Keep it non-technical for marketing.
Prashant: For backend, will add a serverless endpoint that returns sanitized estimate and sets a tracking cookie so analytics can link estimate -> conversion. Ping @eng-frontend for CORS and rate limits.
Mike: Can we try two naming treatments for tiers in the test? Option 1: "Starter / Developer / Business / Enterprise" Option 2: "Hobby / Pro / Scale / Enterprise" Only change names on variant A.
Sarah: Good call — also QA the microcopy for non-US currencies and monthly vs annual toggles.
Julia: I'll fork the embed, wire up accessibility fixes, and push a staging preview.
deploy-bot: staging preview deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/pricing/price-composer-embed (sha: d4f7c1) :rocket:
Ana: Great — can marketing draft the test announcement + tracking tags? I'll coordinate with growth. I'll put a short checklist: 1) copy 2) analytics events 3) hubspot field mapping 4) A/B rollout config 5) post-test report template.
Prashant: I'll handle hubspot mapping and the serverless endpoint. Tag me when staging is live.
Mike: I'll own the naming variants and build the experiment in Optimizely.
Sarah: I'll own the post-test analysis: LIFT in demos, trial-to-paid, and lead quality score.
Ana: Sweet. Quick timeline: staging this week, internal review Mon, soft launch Tue morning, 4-week run.
Julia: PR incoming in ~3 hours.
Sarah: :thumbsup:
